meta.name: pdf-processing-pro
meta.description: Production-ready PDF processing with forms, tables, OCR, validation, and batch operations. Use when working with complex PDF workflows in production environments, processing large volumes of PDFs, or requiring robust error handling and validation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 批量处理PDF表单、表格、OCR和验证
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要自动化处理大量PDF文档
copy.tagline_en: Process PDF forms, tables, OCR, and validation in batch
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to automate processing of large volumes of PDFs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能分析并填写 PDF 表单、提取表格和文字、OCR 识别扫描件、合并拆分 PDF，处理出错时会给出明确的错误信息和退出码。
howto.when: 当在生产环境中处理复杂 PDF 工作流、批量处理大量 PDF，或要求可靠的错误处理和验证时，技能会接管。

say.text: 帮我分析这个 PDF 表单里的字段结构
say.note: 将运行 analyze_form.py 并输出字段 JSON

say.text: 把这个 PDF 中的表格提取成 CSV 文件
say.note: 将调用 extract_tables.py 完成提取

say.text: 合并这两个 PDF 文件

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze and fill PDF forms, extract tables and text, OCR scanned documents, merge/split PDFs, and provide clear error messages and exit codes on failure.
howto.when_en: Triggered when working on complex PDF workflows in production, processing large volumes of PDFs, or requiring reliable error handling and validation.

say_en.text: Analyze the field structure of this PDF form
say_en.note: Runs analyze_form.py and outputs field JSON

say_en.text: Extract tables from this PDF into a CSV file
